primary: Single native-tail characterization of actual synchronous flush-set host wait plus all-request external-arrival service results. No policy comparison or SLO goodput claim.
slo: No application SLO. Inherited20point frontier is diagnostic only.
hypothesis: Pending STORE acknowledgments may or may not imply exposed wait. Native victim transfer jobs enter jobs_to_flush, but work may already complete or other dependencies may cover the same STORE prefix.
claim_ceiling: Read-only observer characterization. Job-set wait is not per-job DMA time, removable cost, or alternate-victim causal service benefit. Observer overhead not isolated. Same original mixed burst input and all policies.
retention: Preserve previous results and failures; one new observer-only cell, no automatic restart.
simple_comparators: Diagnostic ordinary max remaining declared budget, tie latest suffix index, plus same-held/computed-pages restricted version. Neither is a full CacheOPT implementation or actual alternate trajectory.

resource_handoff.scope: Only first GPU boundary before model preflight/CUDA. Whole-group1800s process ceiling includes initial clearance; later boundaries unchanged. No process signals or automatic retry.

triton_cache_seed.key_policy: First source wins each complete key directory:39 tail-first keys,2 additional host-near-first fused_moe keys; never mix files of a key
triton_cache_seed.copy_policy: Independent copies per arm; group child_paths relocated to that arm; extern_libs and compiled bytes unchanged; no previous-arm cache feedback
triton_cache_seed.development_status: Already observed exploration data, not independent confirmation

diagnostic_question: Does the actual worker.wait expose meaningful host blocking at victim-related flushes, or is pending count an already-overlapped proxy?
decision_rule: One cell only. With negligible exposed wait, close immediate pending-dependency cost explanation without a selector. With meaningful wait and legal dependency-changing choices, next use a bounded actual same-release intervention and full-request costs.
shared_budget_note: No expenditure telemetry or known remaining multi-session allowance. 1800s is a process ceiling, not a monetary budget estimate.

budget_mixture.selection: First 40 request IDs sorted by (sha256(UTF-8(prefix + request_id)), request_id).
budget_mixture.semantics: Assigned maximum output budgets, not future EOS labels. No execution outcomes used. Not a performance-gain comparison with the uniform-budget workload.

resource_disk_basis: One-cell observer run; recent single-cell expanded output+archives+private caches total about0.6GiB. Reserve2GiB entrance (~3x footprint). Does not modify past frozen4GiB plans or any GPU/host scientific budget.
